output.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.discount_pct > 0 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_revenue_share_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines l JOIN marts.fct_orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Revenue is restricted to completed orders (is_revenue = true) with order_date in 2025. Line net_amount is summed for all lines and for lines with discount_pct > 0. The share is discounted net amount divided by total net amount, times 100, rounded to 2 decimals. Lines are joined to fct_orders on order_id to apply the status filter.
